description: How reliably home cooks reproduce the original recipe. Crowd-sourced: populated from submissions by users who attempted the recipe and rated how closely their result matched the original.
orientation: higher = harder to reproduce (results vary widely from the original); lower = reliably reproducible

dimension_definitions.taste_match: User rating of how closely their result tasted like the original (1 = nothing like it, 10 = indistinguishable)
dimension_definitions.visual_match: User rating of how closely their result looked like the original (1 = looks completely different, 10 = looks identical)

scoring.method: reproducibility = 11 - weighted_average(taste_match, visual_match); higher submitted matches produce a lower (easier) reproducibility score

submission_schema.attempts: integer (how many tries it took to get this result)

confidence.description: Reliability of the aggregate score based on number of submissions

unrated.note: No replication data yet; metric is provisional
